Mega Evolution series · MEP

Mega Evolution Black Star Promos

Released September 26, 2025 · 112 cards

Expanded

Mega Evolution Black Star Promos is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on September 26, 2025. It has 112 cards. It includes 109 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

53 illustrators worked on Mega Evolution Black Star Promos. Most cards: Saboteri (29), 5ban Graphics (14), Shimaris Yukichi (4), Taiga Kasai (3), Jiro Sasumo (2), Krgc (2), Nisota Niso (2), Ounishi (2).
